s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 3))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    minr = min(r for r, c in pts)
    minc = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = {(r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in pts}
    sh = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    sw = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    for r in range(h - sh + 1):
        for c in range(w - sw + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
